name: J. Brendan Day
service_line_reviewed: Service reviewed: Appointed April 3, 2023 through September 13, 2026. Selected decisions: 3.

biography.text: Day earned a B.A. from Dartmouth College (2005) and a J.D. from Seton Hall University School of Law (2008). He clerked for U.S. District Judge Katharine S. Hayden and Third Circuit Judge Michael A. Chagares, practiced at Sullivan & Cromwell, and served as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in New Jersey, including as Attorney-in-Charge of the Trenton office and deputy chief of the Criminal Division.
